text_block_list.text:
When I went to the shopping street for 
some errands... a mysterious crowd had 
gathered.

Thank you for your vote! Thank you so 
muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, hold on a sec. What's all this 
fuss about?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Is that a politician giving a speech 
here? Seems like the crowd is pretty hyped 
up, though..."

text_block_list.name: Bakushining Politician?
text_block_list.text:
In return for everyone's support, I will 
continue to Bakushin onward!
choice_data_list: H-Hold on, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see, so it's actually the class 
representative. That's the plight of the 
popular kid, huh~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! If it isn't Trainer-san! Look at this 
clean, fair vote!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You could say that, too!!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Getting to meet you as well, Trainer, is 
so exciting! I'm rooting for both of you!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! I shall certainly live up 
to those expectations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Through Bakushin-level feats!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~... Huh? A Bakushin-esque... 
triumph...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! Look at those expressions! 
Practically begging to see it, aren't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm?! What are you talking about, 
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling your manifesto is what makes a 
class president! Bakushin-ing is what 
makes an honor student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, I'm so happy that I just 
want to run!! So, without further ado—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Is that Nature-san over there!? What 
impeccable timing! What a marvelous 
opportunity!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Nat-chan's running too?! Awesome, 
awesome! Go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Run?! Wait, why me too?! There's no way 
you need someone like me...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu... Very well! Bakushin only truly 
shines when clashing fiercely in a race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here we go!! Baaakushin, bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wait?! H-Hey, Trainer over there?! 
Do something about your trainee, will ya?!

I hurriedly chased after a runaway Sakura 
Bakushin O... and caught up to her a short 
distance away just as she ran out of 
breath.
